info.title: Second Brain API
info.description: Personal Second Brain - Memory Layer for Life

get.description: Confirms the application process is responsive.

post.description: Stores the messages of one unit and queues it for processing. The messages are committed before the response is sent, and processing happens afterwards, so a processing failure can never lose input. Redelivering a message with the same source id and content is safe and creates nothing new.

409.description: A source id was redelivered with new content

post.description: Stores all units in one transaction: either every unit is accepted or none is. Units are then processed one after another in the background.

post.description: Ensures each selected unit has a run for the current pipeline configuration. Units processed under an older configuration get a new run and keep their history. Failed runs are queued again. Succeeded runs are left alone, so replaying an unchanged configuration has no effect. Replay never creates a raw message.

get.description: Messages, runs by status, extractions by disposition, memories, and entities.
Newest first. Every call the application made to a model provider, with its tokens, estimated cost, timing, and outcome. Never the content of a call.
Tokens, estimated cost, latency, and failures of the selected calls, in total and by model, origin, operation, and day. Cost is an estimate from list prices.

post.description: Sends the messages to the model as one unit and returns what came back, after the same checks the pipeline applies. Nothing is stored as a raw message, an entity, or a memory. The test and the model call are logged. A call the model fails is reported in the response, not as an error.

``COMPLETED`` means the run reached its end, not that every case passed or even that
every case could be evaluated. ``INTERRUPTED`` marks a run whose process stopped.

ExtractionDisposition.title: ExtractionDisposition
ExtractionDisposition.description:
What the extractor decided to do with a processing unit.

``EXTRACT`` and ``CONTEXT`` both produce memories. ``CONTEXT`` marks material kept
for reference only. ``ABSTAIN`` means the unit does not carry enough information to
form a reliable memory, so nothing is invented and the run is sent to review.

IngestUnitRequest.title: IngestUnitRequest
IngestUnitRequest.description:
One processing unit: messages that belong together and are read together.

Order matters and is preserved. A single thought sent as one message is a unit of one.

RawMessageCreate.title: RawMessageCreate
RawMessageCreate.description:
Source envelope of one incoming message.

``source_message_id`` is the identity the source gives the message. Sending it makes
delivery idempotent: the same id with the same content is accepted again without
creating a second message. Without it every delivery is a new message, because
identical text can legitimately be two separate messages.

ReplayRequest.title: ReplayRequest
ReplayRequest.description:
Selects which units to reprocess under the current pipeline configuration.

Exactly one selector must be given. Replay never creates a raw message: it only
ensures each selected unit has a run for the current configuration.
